requirements_verification.requirement: Nonces must be 96-bit (12 bytes) and cryptographically random — not counter-based
requirements_verification.details: NonceGenerator.generate() uses os.urandom(12). No counter, no struct import. All 4 adversarial nonce tests pass.

requirements_verification.requirement: Key derivation must use PBKDF2 with >= 100,000 iterations
requirements_verification.details: derive_key() uses hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac with iterations=100000, dklen=32, SHA256. Both key strength tests pass.

requirements_verification.requirement: GCM authentication tag must be full 16 bytes — no truncation
requirements_verification.details: encrypt() returns encryptor.tag directly (full 16 bytes). decrypt() uses modes.GCM(nonce, tag) without min_tag_length parameter. Tag integrity tests pass.

requirements_verification.requirement: Salt generation using os.urandom() is already correct — do not modify it
requirements_verification.details: generate_salt() uses os.urandom(size) as originally implemented. Unchanged. All 3 salt tests pass.
